::: {#exm-input-matrix}

#### The input matrix and outcome vector of the first five cars

In the `mtcars` data frame,
take the fuel economy `mpg` as the outcome $\outvar$
and the gross horsepower `hp` and weight `wt` as the $\inputdim = 2$ inputs.
The first five cars give a [data set](#def-data-set) of $\nobs = 5$ observations.

```{r}
#| label: input-matrix-mtcars
#| code-fold: false

# take the first five cars from the mtcars data frame
cars5 <- head(mtcars, 5)

# stack the two inputs as columns, one row per car
X_cars5 <- as.matrix(cars5[, c("hp", "wt")])

# stack the outcomes into one vector
y_cars5 <- cars5$mpg

# show the input matrix and the outcome vector side by side
cbind(X_cars5, mpg = y_cars5)
```

The [input matrix](#def-input-matrix) `X_cars5` has `r nrow(X_cars5)` rows, one per car,
and `r ncol(X_cars5)` columns, one per input variable.
The [outcome vector](#def-outcome-vector) `y_cars5` has `r length(y_cars5)` entries, one per car.

:::
